notes.title: Automaton Arena vA0.94.00 is Live! Happy (belated) pride month!
notes.content:
[h1]New Things:[/h1]
[list][*]Upgraded bot loadouts structure so lots of customization can be added in the future![/*][*]Added 20 selectable prides for bots! (press (Menu) select and / or special on a bots style to get started! )[/*][*]Bots get a special flag reflecting active pride![/*][*]Beam Welder's visuals change based on active pride![/*][*]RightInc and RightOff arenas change visuals to reflect the prides of active players![/*][/list]
[h1]Improvements Made?[/h1]
[list][*]Feeble attempts were made to contain BallBot's dark quantum properties, but their rain of chaos continues unfettered[/*][/list]
[h1]Bugs Squashed:[/h1]
[list][*]A handful of small bugs and crashes[/*][/list]


[h1][/h1]
[h1]Thank you so much for your continued support![b] Development of single player content begins now! I hope you look forward to it!
[/b][/h1]
